name.description: The patient's name. Preserve the supplied text exactly; do not correct, reformat, or infer it.

age.description: The patient's age in years. Use the supplied whole number exactly; do not infer or alter it.

gender.description: The patient's gender as supplied. Preserve the supplied text exactly and do not infer or reinterpret it.

symptoms.description: The patient's reported symptoms. Preserve the supplied text and meaning exactly; do not diagnose, interpret, or add details.

symptomsDuration.description: The supplied duration of the patient's symptoms. Preserve the supplied text exactly; do not convert, summarize, or infer it.

severity.description: The patient's supplied symptom severity. Preserve the supplied text exactly; do not reinterpret, normalize, or infer it.

action.description: The recommended action supplied for the email. Reproduce this value exactly in the Recommended Action line without editing or adding information.

Email_Body.description: One plain-text email body containing Name, Age, Gender, Symptoms, Symptoms Duration, and Severity on separate labeled lines, followed by a Recommended Action line whose value is reproduced exactly from the action input, and ending with the exact lines "Best regards," and "Patient Assistance System.". Do not include a subject, diagnosis, interpretation, or any additional content.
